title: Personal Knowledge Hub
description: This very site: a static, installable personal knowledge base. Markdown-first content, a zero-dependency build script, and a small vanilla-JS frontend.
bodyHtml:
This very site: a static, installable personal knowledge base.

Markdown-first content, a zero-dependency build script, and a small vanilla-JS frontend — no framework, no bundler, deployable straight to GitHub Pages.

  • PWA with offline support
  • Notes, projects, and links all driven by data/content files

title: Data Evaluation Platform
description: Internal platform for validating and scoring large-scale datasets before release. Built pipelines that automatically flag anomalies and schema drift.
bodyHtml:
Internal platform for validating and scoring large-scale datasets before release.

Built pipelines that automatically flag anomalies, missing fields, and schema drift across incoming data batches, cutting manual review time significantly.

  • Stack: Python, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, GCP
  • Impact: reduced manual QA effort for 10+ downstream teams

title: Developer Productivity Toolkit
description: A set of internal CLI tools to speed up common engineering workflows, automating environment setup, log triage, and dataset sampling.
bodyHtml:
A set of internal CLI tools to speed up common engineering workflows.

Automated repetitive tasks like environment setup, log triage, and dataset sampling into a single command-line toolkit shared across teams.

  • Stack: Python, Typer, Docker
